title: Small molecule helical emitters
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,1999-2023
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01270H, Review Article
Tadashi Mori
The review outlines key molecular design strategies centered on helical emitters that have recently enabled significant breakthroughs, pushing luminescence dissymmetry factors (gCPL) beyond the 0.01 threshold.
